$description: Bounded, sequential background reflection. Paused by default; enabling requires a human-chosen run ID.

recurring.$description: Explicitly authorize continued cheap checks and UTC daily allowance resets; default false.

dailyTurnLimit.$description: Maximum delivered inputs per UTC day under the opted-in recurring policy.

dailyStepLimit.$description: Maximum admitted model steps per UTC day; not a monetary spending cap.

enabled.$description: Opt into one finite run. Never enabled by the agent.

runId.$description: Choose a new value to authorize a fresh bounded budget; reusing it never replenishes budget.

heartbeatMinutes.$description: Cheap local MAIN check interval while a run waits for substantive unseen input. Not a model-request schedule.

maxTurns.$description: Maximum deliveries in one explicit run, at most three.

maxSteps.$description: Maximum admitted model steps in the entire run.

maxTokens.$description: Native per-response output cap; not a monetary guarantee.

cooldownMs.$description: Minimum idle delay between useful reflection turns.

maxRunMs.$description: Maximum elapsed run time; zero disables this timer, not the turn/step caps.
